hero.label: Made for Finku
hero.headline: I want to help Finku bring financial clarity to Indonesia.
hero.subheadline: Southeast Asia's underbanked population represents one of the most meaningful fintech opportunities in the world, and Finku is attacking it with AI-native tooling built for real Indonesian users. I am a BDR with hands-on outbound experience and a track record of turning cold conversations into paying customers, and I want to bring that energy to your growth engine.

whyCompany.title: Indonesia's personal finance gap is massive and largely untouched by great UX
whyCompany.body: With over 270 million people and a historically underserved retail banking population, Indonesia is primed for a mobile-first personal finance product that actually earns user trust. Finku's bet on AI-powered insights rather than generic budgeting templates is exactly the kind of product differentiation that can drive word-of-mouth in a market where trust is everything. That is a BD story I would love to help tell.

whyCompany.title: Early-stage BD hiring means the playbook is still being written
whyCompany.body: Joining a startup at this stage means the outreach sequences, partnership frameworks, and growth motions I help build will actually stick around. I thrive in zero-to-one environments where hustle and iteration matter more than inherited process. At Copygen.ai I was one of the first BDRs and helped the team land 15 to 20 paying clients from scratch, which is exactly the kind of founding energy this moment calls for.

whyCompany.title: My BDR reps and digital marketing training map directly onto Finku's BD needs
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach, LinkedIn sequences, and HubSpot pipelines daily, converting prospects into paying clients for an AI SaaS product. At NextAfter I learned how data-driven messaging and conversion optimization work inside a B2B consultancy, which sharpened my ability to craft outreach that actually lands. Selling an AI value proposition to skeptical buyers is something I have done, and I can do it again for Finku.

quote: I have spent the last year convincing people to trust an AI product they had never heard of before, and I loved every cold call of it. Finku is the kind of mission-driven, market-defining bet I want to grow with, not just work for.
